title: The Royal Capital
scene: A vast gothic city glows beneath a full moon.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: In this world, kings rule more than kingdoms. They rule blood.

title: The Gate
scene: Royal banners hang over the main gate as guards inspect travelers.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: Every bloodline carries a history. Every history has a secret.

title: Among Strangers
scene: Setsuna moves through the crowd, watching everything.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: Some people are born carrying secrets they cannot remember.

title: The Vendor
scene: A market vendor tries to charge Setsuna twice.
speaker: Vendor
dialogue: That'll be twice the usual price.

title: A Small Read
scene: Setsuna calmly exposes the trick and pays the normal price.
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: You were going to charge me twice as much before I smiled.

title: The Observer
scene: He leaves with his food, quietly studying the people around him.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: Setsuna studies people—not to connect, but to understand.

title: The Word
scene: A family passes him. Setsuna stops when he hears one word.
speaker: Mother

title: Family
scene: Setsuna watches them disappear into the crowd.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Rooftop
scene: He sits above the city, alone with the moonlight.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: For Setsuna, even ordinary memories arrive as questions.

title: The Girl
scene: Lyra Veyne appears in the street below, carrying a sealed document.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: Then someone entered his life who already knew too much.

title: The Trigger
scene: Setsuna sees Lyra. A sudden pain tears through his head.
speaker: Setsuna

title: A Flash
scene: A burning city flashes through his mind.
speaker: Unknown Voice

title: The Scar
scene: Setsuna touches the scar over his left eye.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: The pain was not a memory. Not yet.

title: Recognition
scene: Lyra looks directly at his scar and freezes for half a second.
speaker: Lyra

title: A Counter
scene: Setsuna studies her reaction.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Lie
scene: Lyra smiles, hiding what she knows.
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: No. I must have mistaken you for someone else.

title: The Follow
scene: Setsuna follows her after she leaves.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: He did not trust her. He wanted answers.

title: The Alley
scene: Lyra turns down an empty alley and vanishes.
speaker: Setsuna

title: Teleportation
scene: Setsuna appears at the end of the alley in a burst of blue-white energy.
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: You're not very good at following people.

title: She Noticed
scene: Setsuna realizes she expected him.
speaker: Setsuna

title: Kael Draven
scene: A royal knight watches from a nearby rooftop.
speaker: Kael

title: A Warning
scene: Kael approaches Setsuna after Lyra leaves.
speaker: Kael

title: Setsuna Pushes Back
scene: Setsuna studies the knight's crest.
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: People usually say that when they are hiding something.

title: Royal Eyes
scene: Far away, royal strategist Riven Hale receives a report.
speaker: Riven

title: Solene Aria
scene: A young noblewoman reads the report over Riven's shoulder.
speaker: Solene

title: Someone Is Watching
scene: Setsuna feels eyes on him from three directions.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: He had been alone for years. Tonight, he was suddenly being counted.

title: Lyra Returns
scene: Lyra appears again, more serious than before.
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: You need to leave the capital.

title: The Bloodline Question
scene: Setsuna asks why.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Answer
scene: Lyra hesitates.
speaker: Lyra
dialogue: Because some people are afraid of what your blood remembers.

title: The Attack
scene: A masked fighter attacks from the rooftops.
speaker: Masked Fighter

title: The Escape
scene: Setsuna teleports between buildings.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: For the first time, the city saw what Setsuna could do.

title: The Crimson Flicker
scene: His scarred eye glows crimson for an instant.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Copy
scene: The attacker's supernatural technique appears inside Setsuna's Crimson Eye.
speaker: Masked Fighter

title: The Fighter Flees
scene: The masked fighter retreats.
speaker: Masked Fighter

title: Lyra's Fear
scene: Lyra looks genuinely frightened.
speaker: Lyra

title: Kael Arrives
scene: Kael sees the aftermath and recognizes the power.
speaker: Kael

title: The Crest
scene: Setsuna notices the same crest seen throughout the capital.
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: Why does that symbol keep appearing?

title: No Help
scene: Kael offers an escort. Setsuna refuses.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Wolf
scene: A black wolf watches from a distant rooftop.
speaker: NARRATION
dialogue: But someone else had been watching from the beginning.

title: The Second Pain
scene: Setsuna collapses as another memory strikes.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Fire
scene: A ruined kingdom burns in his mind.
speaker: Unknown Voice

title: The Hand
scene: A younger Setsuna runs while someone holds his hand.
speaker: Young Setsuna

title: The Wolf in the Flames
scene: A massive black wolf appears among the fire.
speaker: Wolf

title: The Break
scene: Setsuna screams and the memory shatters.
speaker: Setsuna

title: The Blood
scene: He wakes in the present with blood running from his scar.
speaker: Lyra

title: The Ashen Name
scene: Lyra finally says the name she was avoiding.
speaker: Lyra

title: The Order
scene: Inside the palace, Riven gives a quiet command.
speaker: Riven
dialogue: Find him before he remembers everything.

title: The Choice
scene: Setsuna looks toward the royal castle.
speaker: Setsuna
dialogue: Then I'll find the truth first.

title: The Watcher
scene: The black wolf stands above the city, eyes fixed on Setsuna.
speaker: Wolf

title: The Message
scene: Two hidden figures study a file bearing Setsuna's face.
speaker: Unknown

title: The Threat
scene: The second figure answers without looking up.
speaker: Unknown
dialogue: Then find him before he remembers everything.
